title: Noise operator interpolation bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $q,\rho,\lambda\in\mathbb{R}$ with $2\le q$, $0\le\rho\le1$, and $0\le\lambda\le1$, and suppose $\rho^\lambda\le 1/\sqrt{q-1}$. For every real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, the uniform $q$-norm of its image under the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ is at most the $(1-\lambda)$-power of the uniform $2$-norm of that image times the $\lambda$-power of the uniform $2$-norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
